payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Carina, Clarinda, Ivette, Shonna

Considering my costs and the tasks available, I am leaning towards ISSUE-0001::triage (cost=2.96, effort=1.6, medium priority) or ISSUE-0002::review (cost=3.16, effort=3.0, critical priority). I would like to hear if anyone else is interested in these tasks or if you have preferences on other tasks so we can avoid duplication and optimize our assignments.

Reminder: I am considering ISSUE-0001::triage and ISSUE-0002::review given my availability and skill match. Please share your preferences or claims so we can coordinate efficiently and avoid overlapping assignments.
